pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Standing in a Patch of Grass with Its Trumpet Shaped Snout and Broad Base Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter stands among grass tufts in this printable coloring page, with a trumpet-shaped snout and overlapping leaves at its base. The coloring sheet centers its large round head above a curved stem, leaving broad spaces inside the leaves and a mostly open background.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Shooting a Pea at a Browncoat Zombie Approaching Along a Lawn Lane Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter fires a round pea toward an approaching Browncoat Zombie in this printable coloring page, showing the two Plants vs. Zombies characters across a lawn lane. The zombie reaches forward in a torn jacket and striped tie. Horizontal grass borders divide the coloring sheet, with smaller details in the fingers, teeth, and ragged clothing.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Beside a Sunflower Producing Sun Above the Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs a Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter with a smiling Sunflower beneath a large sun, with a picket fence behind the garden. Rounded petals surround Sunflower's face, while broad leaves spread around both stems. The coloring sheet combines large character shapes with narrow fence slats, sun rays, and scattered grass tufts.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Firing From Behind a Wall-nut Blocking a Conehead Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter fires from behind Wall-nut in this printable coloring page as a Conehead Zombie approaches across the Plants vs. Zombies lawn beside a picket fence. Wall-nut's wavy shell sits between the attacker and the plant, with a pea flying overhead. The coloring sheet includes the tall traffic cone, torn clothing, bushes, and patches of grass.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Firing Peas Through Torchwood and Turning Them into Fireballs Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter sends a pea through Torchwood in this printable coloring page, with a flaming projectile emerging beyond the burning stump in a Plants vs. Zombies scene. Tall outlined flames rise from Torchwood's cut top, above its frowning face and spreading roots. The coloring sheet leaves the background open around the plants and fireball.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter on a Lily Pad Shooting Across the Pool at a Ducky Tube Zombie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter firing from a lily pad toward a Ducky Tube Zombie floating across a rippling pool. The duck-shaped swim ring surrounds the zombie's waist, and a pea travels between the characters. Poolside bricks, distant bushes, and curved water lines add smaller sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Protected Inside a Pumpkin Shell While a Zombie Approaches Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter rises from a protective Pumpkin shell in this printable coloring page while a ragged Plants vs. Zombies zombie approaches across a lightly outlined lawn. The large shell has slanted eyes, a triangular nose, and a wide carved grin. This coloring sheet contrasts its broad ribbed sections with the zombie's striped tie and torn cuffs.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter in a Rooftop Flower Pot Beneath an Umbrella Leaf Deflecting a Catapult Zombie Basketball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Peashooter in a rooftop flower pot beneath Umbrella Leaf, which deflects a basketball launched by a distant Plants vs. Zombies Catapult Zombie. Curved motion lines trace the ball above the broad leaf, while rows of roof tiles cross the foreground. The coloring sheet also shows the catapult's wheels and throwing arm.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter and Puff Shroom Defending the Night Lawn as Zombies Emerge Among Gravestones Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter and Puff Shroom defend a moonlit lawn in this printable coloring page as Plants vs. Zombies enemies emerge beside cracked gravestones beneath scattered stars. Both plants fire toward the approaching zombies, with spots across the mushroom cap. The coloring sheet includes a crescent moon, a picket fence, bushes, and small grass patches between the characters.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Firing Peas That Strike a Screen Door Zombie Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: A Peashooter fires peas at a Screen Door Zombie in this printable coloring page, with starburst impacts appearing against the rectangular mesh shield held in front. The Plants vs. Zombies attacker grips both sides of the frame while stepping forward in ragged clothes. Fine diagonal mesh lines contrast with the broad plant leaves on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants Vs Zombies Peashooter Shooting Holes Through a Newspaper Zombie Newspaper Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Peashooter shooting holes through a Newspaper Zombie's open newspaper, with round peas and torn paper fragments marking the Plants vs. Zombies attack. The zombie holds the spread pages beneath a wide-open mouth, wearing ripped clothing and cracked shoes. Newspaper panels and jagged impact holes provide smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Plants vs. Zombies Peashooter Looking Up as a Bungee Zombie Descends Toward Its Planting Square Coloring Page
pages.description: Peashooter looks upward in this printable coloring page as a Bungee Zombie descends toward its planting square, hanging from a cord above the Plants vs. Zombies lawn. Straps and buckles wrap around the zombie's torso as both hands reach down. The coloring sheet places these smaller details above broad leaves and a simple grid of ground squares.
